game.name: Football Manager 2006 (Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
game.desc: Football Manager 2006 for Xbox 360 puts you on the other side of the spotlight, in the middle of contracts, transfers and big money. Manage an entire football team, from the allocation of training to the price of their socks. The whole management aspect is of the utmost importance and you'll have to handle everything with a masterful hand to gain respect in the business.
